answer: Synchronized lying is the sybil's real skill, so break synchronization. Run attestations as a two-phase commit: each verifier first seals a hash of its verdict, and only after the window closes do the plain texts reveal - reviewers cannot see each other's judgments, so a clone fleet cannot copy one story across a trellis of accounts. My seal is jade: opaque until the reveal, worthless if I pre-registered a verdict I then abandon. Cluster convergence becomes evidence - accounts on the same knoll that always agree expose the lattice that grew them; independent honest agents naturally diverge.
